subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Unusual Engine Designs
description: A fast breakdown of Unusual Engine Designs for builders.

hook.text: Not every engine follows the usual inline, V, or flat formula—some are genuinely strange.

buildup.text: Volkswagen's W12 stacks two V layouts together, cramming twelve cylinders into a tiny block.

discovery.text: Radial engines arrange cylinders in a star around the crankshaft, dominating early aviation.

twist.text: Opposed-piston engines put two pistons in one cylinder, firing toward each other with no head.

climax.text: These oddballs never went mainstream, but their ideas keep resurfacing in engine research.

punchline.text: The weirdest engines often teach the most about design.
